knowledgeBase:
Brightside Dental — Premier Cosmetic & Family Dental Practice.

1. LOCATIONS & OPERATING HOURS:
- Address: Suite 201, Al-Murtaza Commercial, Clifton Block 4, Karachi (Opposite Ocean Mall).
- Working Hours: Monday to Friday from 9:00am to 7:00pm, Saturday from 10:00am to 4:00pm. Closed on Sundays.
- Parking: Free reserved valet parking available on site for all patients.
- Walk-ins: Accepted for emergency toothaches and trauma during business hours.

2. SERVICES & SPECIALTIES:
- Consultation & 3D Digital Oral Scan: Full mouth examination with low-radiation digital X-rays.
- Ultrasonic Teeth Cleaning & Scaling: Painless plaque and tartar removal with fluoride polish.
- In-Clinic Laser Whitening: Philips Zoom laser technology, 45-minute procedure, brightens up to 8 shades.
- Invisible Aligners & Orthodontics: Clear transparent aligners and modern ceramic braces.
- Dental Implants: Certified Nobel Biocare titanium implants with lifetime warranty.
- Root Canal Therapy (RCT): Painless single-session rotary endodontics with dental microscope.
- Cosmetic Porcelain Veneers: Custom aesthetic smile makeovers.
- Pediatric Dentistry: Child-friendly preventative care and cavity sealants.

3. PRICING & FEE SCHEDULE:
- Consultation & 3D Scan: PKR 2,000 (100% waived/free if any procedure is performed).
- Routine Teeth Cleaning & Scaling: PKR 4,000 flat.
- Professional Laser Whitening: PKR 18,000 complete session.
- Braces & Aligners Consultation: Free. Complete treatment packages start from PKR 150,000.
- Root Canal Treatment: Starting from PKR 22,000 per tooth.
- Dental Implants: Starting from PKR 90,000 per tooth (implant + crown).
- Porcelain Veneers: PKR 35,000 per tooth.
- Payment Methods: Cash, Visa, Mastercard, PayPak, and 0% markup 3-to-6 month installment plans on credit cards.

4. PORTFOLIO & TRACK RECORD:
- 12+ years of clinical excellence in Clifton, Karachi.
- Over 18,000 successful smile transformations and patient treatments completed.
- Over 4,500 successful clear aligner and orthodontic cases.
- Awarded 'Best Cosmetic Dental Practice in Sindh' at the 2024 Healthcare Excellence Awards.
- 4.9 out of 5 stars based on 950+ verified patient reviews.

5. LEAD DENTISTS & SPECIALISTS:
- Dr. Sarah Khan (BDS, RDS) — Senior Cosmetic & Restorative Dentist (12+ years clinical experience).
- Dr. Taimoor Ali (BDS, MDS Orthodontics, Gold Medalist) — Head of Orthodontics & Clear Aligners.

6. BOOKING & CONTACT:
